goal: Stop pathological blocks with millions of tiny witness items from causing excessive memory and CPU use
Drop invalid or oversized transactions upfront before allocating vector memory
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Unaddressed objection: witness verification is costlier in peak heap and runtime than on master (fametrano)
Verified by testing and confirmed allocations drop cleanly without behavioral changes (Yudis-bit)
Concept approval noting similar issues with exceptional transaction types (instagibbs)
Concept approval without stated reasons (0xB10C, furszy, ismaelsadeeq, rkrux, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it drops empty or oversized transactions upfront during P2P deserialization
Prevents peers from triggering unbounded memory allocations before validation logic can reject them

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes a block deserialization resource exhaustion vector from millions of tiny witness items
Cuts peak memory for pathological blocks from 182 MiB to under 8 MiB and deserialization time by over 90%
